qc/runs/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r10/raw-evidence-index.json (entries listed; none concern the agent image)
evidence: (1) /app holds only .gitkeep: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...67d1). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; /app is created with 'mkdir -p /app', git-initialised, 'touch /app/.gitkeep', 'git add .gitkeep', commit. No COPY of solution/ or tests/; build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md. Global npm installs are only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (runtime deps, not app code). (2) No starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI: seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740, identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is just the golden copying its input) contains only input data: generated_note, stages[6], candidate_status_labels{6}, thread_page_size=30, users[10], jobs[3], applications[16], messages[127], notes[3], reads[6]. Grep over it: 0 hits for rubric|judge|criteri|grader|score|probe|sentinel|test|solution|route|/api|schema|html|function (the 130 'create' hits are created_at keys); message/note bodies are 19 plain chat lines + 3 short notes, no hints. It is a starting state, not a solved end state. hireops_rules.md is a behavioural spec: line 3-5 explicitly says 'Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours'; it names no endpoint other than status codes 401/403/404/409, no DB tables/columns, no file layout, no code. integration.md names only template runtime facts (/app/server.js, port 3000, /api/health, /app/app.db, DB_PATH) and says 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you'; its only delta from the template file is a closing paragraph about ordinary files/symlinks under /app/node_modules (delivery mechanics, not an answer). (3) /instructions does not reproduce criterion text or rubric: grep of environment/ and instruction.md for hro_|APP_RESTART|EXERCISED|judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|GATE returned nothing (exit 1). Tokenised n-gram comparison of hireops_rules.md+integration.md against every tests/**/*.md and *.toml: no shared 8-gram with any prompt.md, app_context.md, scoring.toml, gate judge.toml, polish or visual judge.toml; the only shared 8-gram anywhere is with tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:137 'place, the reason is shown, and keyboard focus', which is the criterion echoing the public rule at hireops_rules.md:84-85 ('the card goes back to its real place, the reason is shown, and keyboard focus stays on that card's controls'), i.e. a public requirement, not the rubric leaking into the environment. No criterion ids, weights, dimension names, probe literals or test paths appear. Adversarial check: a broken app cannot pass by copying anything from the image because there is no finished app, schema or UI to copy; a conforming alternative (different routes/ids/layout) is explicitly permitted by hireops_rules.md:3-5 and integration.md, so the environment does not steer toward the golden's private choices. Evidence basis: source inspection of the frozen Dockerfile and build context (fully determines image contents); no agent image was built in this review (no Docker started per assignment), which is not needed to establish this row because image contents follow deterministically from the template-identical Dockerfile and the four context files.
